ProgramUnit.Name: PORTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PORTS IS
V_RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
V_STR VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN

 -------------------------------------
 V_RG_ID := FIND_GROUP('GROUP_TYPE5');
 IF ID_NULL (V_RG_ID) THEN
 V_STR := 'SELECT PORT_NAME,TO_CHAR(PORT_CD) FROM SD_PORTS';
 V_RG_ID := CREATE_GROUP_FROM_QUERY ('GROUP_TYPE5', V_STR);
 END IF;
 
 IF POPULATE_GROUP (V_RG_ID) = 0 THEN
 POPULATE_LIST ('PORT',V_RG_ID);
 
 END IF;
---------------------------------------------
 

 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER (7 );
 DECL_T VARCHAR2(600);
 CHK VARCHAR2(500);
 CNT VARCHAR2(600);
 RET NUMBER;
BEGIN
---------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT
count(DCLTN.PORT_CD)INTO V_COUNT 
FROM

DCLTN_TYPES DCLTNT,
SD_PORTS L_SDP,
SD_PORTS SDP,
IMPORTERS L_IMP,
DECLARATIONS DCLTN,
COUNTRIES CTRY,
DCLTN_ITEMS DCLTN_IT,
DCLTN_TYPES DCLTNT2,
HARMONIZED_TARIFF HT
WHERE

DCLTN.PORT_CD=:port AND
TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') BETWEEN TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') AND TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') AND
--TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') >= TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') AND
--TO_CHAR(DCLTN.DCLTN_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') <= TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') AND

DCLTN.FINAL_CTRY_CD<>100 AND
((NVL(NVL(ORGNL_DUTY,0)-NVL(EXMTD_DUTY,0),0)<>0 AND :CHECK1=1) OR(:CHECK1=0)) AND
(DCLTN.FINAL_CTRY_CD=:P_CTRY OR :P_CTRY IS NULL) AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_STA_CD= 9 AND
(
(DCLTN.EXIT_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL AND
 DCLTN.EXIT_DCLTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND
 DCLTN.EXIT_DOC_DATE IS NOT NULL AND
 DCLTN.EXIT_DOC_NBR IS NOT NULL AND
 :P_PAY=1) 
OR
((DCLTN.EXIT_PORT_CD IS NULL OR 
 DCLTN.EXIT_DCLTN_TYPE IS NULL OR
 DCLTN.EXIT_DOC_DATE IS NULL OR
 DCLTN.EXIT_DOC_NBR IS NULL )AND
 :P_PAY=2) 
OR 
(:P_PAY=3)
)
AND
DCLTN_IT.PORT_CD = DCLTN.PORT_CD AND
DCLTN_IT.DCLTN_ISN = DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN AND
DCLTN.PORT_CD = L_IMP.PORT_CD AND
DCLTN.AGENT_NBR = L_IMP.IMPR_NBR AND
DCLTN.PORT_CD = SDP.PORT_CD AND
DCLTN.EXIT_PORT_CD = L_SDP.PORT_CD (+) AND
DCLTN.DCLTN_TYPE_CD = DCLTNT.TYPE_ID AND
DCLTN.EXIT_DCLTN_TYPE =DCLTNT2.TYPE_ID (+) AND
DCLTN.FINAL_CTRY_CD = CTRY.CTRY_CD and
DCLTN_IT.FINAL_TARIFF_CD = HT.HRMNZD_CODE
;
---------------------------------------------------------------------
 IF v_count > 0 then 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PORT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CTRY',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_CTRY);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PAY',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_PAY);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'SELECT1',TEXT_PARAMETER,:SELECT2);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'CHECK1',TEXT_PARAMETER,:CHECK1);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 

END ;

PROCEDURE CTRY IS
V_RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
V_STR VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN

 -------------------------------------
 V_RG_ID := FIND_GROUP('GROUP_TYPE');
 IF ID_NULL (V_RG_ID) THEN
 V_STR := 'SELECT '' ''||CRTY_ARBC_NAME,TO_CHAR(CTRY_CD) FROM COUNTRIES WHERE CTRY_CD IN
 (SELECT CTRY_CD FROM CTRY_GROUP_DETAILS WHERE CTRY_GRP_STAT = 1
 AND CTRY_GRP_NBR = 1 AND CTRY_CD <>100)';
 V_RG_ID := CREATE_GROUP_FROM_QUERY ('GROUP_TYPE', V_STR);
 END IF;

 POPULATE_LIST ('P_CTRY',V_RG_ID);
 
 END IF;
---------------------------------------------

DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 
 --:FINANCE_DT := revenue.get_fiscal_year_start(:start_dt);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PORT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DCLTN_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,0);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 END;
